title: How Does CSS Reach the Browser?

blocks.content: Course: CSS Fundamentals for Your First Webpage
How Does CSS Reach the Browser?
Before we start styling anything seriously, there's one practical question worth answering:
How does the browser even know about your CSS?
CSS doesn't magically apply itself. It has to be attached to HTML in a specific way.
There are three ways to do that.
We won't use all of them — but understanding them helps you read real codebases and avoid confusion later.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
